item.title: Philippines Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in Philippines on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: GBP/JPY rebounds from two-month low on weaker JPY; retakes 208.00 ahead of UK CPI
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross attracts some buyers during the Asian session on Wednesday and moves away from a two-month trough, around the 207.25-207.20 area, which it touched the previous day.

item.title: When is the UK CPI data and how could it affect GBP/USD?
item.description: The United Kingdom (UK) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for January is scheduled to be published today at 07:00 GMT.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News & Forecast: GBP/USD trades slightly lower
item.description: GBP/USD trades slightly lower at around 1.3556 as of writing. The 20-period Exponential Moving Average (EMA) trends lower at 1.3593 and continues to cap rebounds. Price holds beneath this gauge, maintaining a short-term bearish bias.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Maintains bullish tone above 108.50, Australian jobs data in focus
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross holds steady near 108.55 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Growing optimism around Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s pro-stimulus policy agenda could support the Japanese Yen (JPY) and act as a headwind for the cross.

item.title: US Dollar Index edges up to near 97.20 in countdown to FOMC Minutes
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trades 0.1% higher to near 97.20 during the early European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: USD/INR trades flat as focus shifts to FOMC Minutes
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens almost flat against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair is expected to wobble near its current levels at around 90.80 as investors await the release of Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) Minutes at 19:00 GMT.

item.title: GBP/USD: Data weakness feeds BoE easing bets – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank analysts Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note that the Pound is underperforming after a disappointing UK employment report. Softer job gains and wages keep domestic risks elevated into CPI, retail sales and PMI data.

item.title: Gold sticks to intraday gains; remains below $4,950 ahead of FOMC Minutes
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its steady intraday ascent and climbs to a fresh daily peak heading into the European session on Tuesday.
